cards.text: Alter-Ego Action: Choose a player to search their deck for a player side scheme and add it to their hand. Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a player side scheme.

cards.name: Run Them to Ground
cards.text: Victory 0. When Defeated: Resolve each of the following: • Skip the next villain phase. • Deal each player 1 facedown encounter card (immediately). • The villain cannot take damage until the start of the next (unskipped) villain phase.

cards.name: Grapnel Launcher
cards.text: Restricted. Hero Action: Discard this card → make a basic thwart without exhausting (even if you are exhausted). For this thwart, your hero gets +1 THW and ignores the patrol keyword and any crisis icons ([crisis]) in play.

cards.name: Entrapment
cards.text: Max 1 per player. Alter-Ego Response (attack): After the villain schemes, change to hero form and discard this card → deal damage to the villain equal to the amount of threat placed by that activation.

cards.name: Hellcat
cards.text: If your identity has the [[Defender]] trait, this card gains: "Action: Put Hellcat into play from your hand. At the end of the phase, discard her."

cards.name: Joys of Life
cards.text: Alliance. Action: Choose: • Exhaust a [[Civilian]] alter-ego → ready a hero or ally. • Exhaust a hero or ally → ready a [[Civilian]] alter-ego.

cards.name: Unbreakable Bond
cards.text: Team-Up (Jessica Jones and Luke Cage). Max 1 per deck. Hero Action: (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme. Heal a total of 3 damage from among Jessica Jones and Luke Cage.

cards.name: Second Chance
cards.text: Victory 0. When Defeated: Each player may shuffle all of their identity-specific cards from their discard pile into their deck.

cards.name: Defend Our City
cards.text: [star] Hinder 1[per_hero]. Prerequisite ([[Defender]]). Victory 0. When Defeated: Each player may search their deck and discard pile for a Team-Up card and add it to their hand. Until the end of the phase, reduce the cost to play each Team-Up card by 1.

cards.name: Innate Aggression
cards.text: Starting. (You may add this card to your hand before drawing your starting hand.) Your hero gets +1 ATK.

cards.name: Shakedown
cards.text: Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player. Response: After you attack and exactly defeat a minion, exhaust this card → remove threat from a scheme equal to that minion's base SCH.

cards.name: Innate Perception
cards.text: Starting. (You may add this card to your hand before drawing your starting hand.) Your hero gets +1 THW.

cards.name: Innate Inspiration
cards.text: Starting. (You may add this card to your hand before drawing your starting hand.) Each ally you control gets +1 hit point.

cards.name: Echo
cards.text: Reduce the amount of damage Echo takes from each enemy attack by your hero's DEF.

cards.name: Lay Low
cards.text: Victory 0. When Defeated: Each player may change to alter-ego form. Heal damage from each alter-ego equal to its REC.

cards.name: Mitigated Threat
cards.text: Attach to a card. Attached card loses each [acceleration], [amplify], [crisis], and [hazard] icon. Forced Response: At the end of the round, each player may spend 1 resource of any type. If any player does not, discard this card.

cards.name: Luke Cage
cards.text: Unbreakable Skin — Luke Cage can have any number of tough status cards. Attacks against Luke Cage lose piercing. Forced Response: After a tough status card is discarded from Luke Cage, he takes 1 unpreventable damage (ignoring tough).

cards.name: Luke Cage
cards.text: Unbreakable Skin — Luke Cage can have any number of tough status cards. Attacks against Luke Cage lose piercing. Action: Search your deck and discard pile for the Burstein Process upgrade and add it to your hand. (Limit once per phase.)

cards.name: Jessica Jones
cards.text: [star] Jessica Jones gets +1 THW for each tough status card on your identity (to a maximum of +4 THW).

cards.name: Harlem's Hero
cards.text: Hero Action: Give Luke Cage a tough status card. For each tough status card on Luke Cage, choose a character you control and ready it.

cards.name: Knuckle Sandwich
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 3 damage to an enemy. You may discard a tough status card from Luke Cage to return this event to your hand.

cards.name: "Stand with Me!"
cards.text: Hero Action (thwart): Give Luke Cage a tough status card. Remove 1 threat from a scheme for each tough status card on Luke Cage (to a maximum of 5).

cards.name: "Sweet Christmas!"
cards.text: [star] Reduce the cost to play this card by 1 for each tough status card on Luke Cage. Hero Action (attack): Deal 5 damage to the villain and each minion engaged with you.

cards.name: Fogwell's Gym
cards.text: Response: After a tough status card is discarded from a [[Defender]] character, exhaust Fogwell's gym → ready that character.

cards.name: Burstein Process
cards.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Burstein Process → give Luke Cage a tough status card (2 tough status cards instead if he has none).

cards.name: Cruisin' for a Bruisin'
cards.text: Attach to a minion. Max 1 per minion. Attacks against attached minion deal 2 additional damage and gain overkill. Response: After you play this card, engage attached minion.

cards.name: Metal Bracer
cards.text: Luke Cage gets retaliate 1. Hero Interrupt: When any amount of damage would be dealt to Luke Cage, exhaust Metal Bracer → reduce that damage by 1.

cards.name: Power Man
cards.text: Hero Response: After a tough status card is discarded from Luke Cage, exhaust Power Man → draw a card.

cards.name: Iron Fist
cards.text: Interrupt: When Iron Fist defends against an enemy attack, prevent damage from that attack equal to Iron Fist's ATK.

cards.name: Misty Knight
cards.text:
Toughness.
[star] Misty Knight gets +2 ATK and +2 THW while she has a tough status card.

cards.name: Valkyrie
cards.text: Toughness. Interrupt: When another ally would be defeated, discard Valkyrie (from play) → instead heal that ally until they have 1 hit point remaining.

cards.name: Take a Stand
cards.text: Hero Response: After your hero defends, each ally you control gets +1 THW and +1 ATK until the end of the player phase.

cards.name: Defensive Formation
cards.text: Uses (3 block counters). Action: Exhaust this card and remove 1 block counter from it → give a [[Defender]] ally a tough status card.

cards.name: Righteous Purpose
cards.text:
Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player.
Each character you control that has exactly 1 hit point remaining gets +2 THW and +2 ATK.

cards.name: Hulk
cards.text: Hulk gets +1 ATK for each rage counter here. Response: After the villain attacks you, place 1 rage counter here.

cards.name: She-Hulk
cards.text: Toughness. Response: After She-Hulk enters play, give your identity a tough status card.

cards.name: Dynamic Duo
cards.text: Action: Search your deck and discard pile for a Team-Up card and an ally named by that card's Team-Up keyword. Add those cards to your hand. (Shuffle.)

cards.name: Power Man and Iron Fist
cards.text: Team-Up (Iron Fist and Luke Cage). Max 1 per deck. Hero Action (attack): Deal 2 damage to an enemy and give a tough status card to a character.

cards.name: Size Advantage
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 3 damage to an enemy (6 damage instead if you have the [[Giant]] trait or more remaining hit points than that enemy).

cards.name: Observe
cards.text: Hero Action: The villain schemes. Give your hero a tough status card.

cards.name: Toughen Up
cards.text: Response: After you recover, if your remaining hit points are equal to or greater than your base hit points, exhaust Toughen Up → give your identity a tough status card.

cards.name: Black Belt
cards.text:
Play only if any player controls a [[Martial Artist]] card.
Attach to a friendly character. Max 1 per character.
Attached character gets +1 hit point and gains the [[Martial Artist]] trait.
